fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects deletion of local audit logs
fields.name: Indicator Removal on Host - Clear Mac System Logs
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "/rm" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/unlink" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/shred") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "/var/log" or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "/Users/" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "/Library/Logs/"))))
